pr.title: Core v2: post-VALIDATED_DRAFT publication-surface revalidation / authority rebind
pr.body:
## Status

`HUMAN_FULL_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_APPROVED / READY_TO_MERGE`

Human approval was given for frozen candidate `f3cdd485fe3d2ba922846b8e6cfc81d46f5bf259` / tree `91b6b0a2e00faa106769ad4dd4282ded7d90e56c` under the project threat model: repository, GitHub account, and authorized operator are trusted; intentional malicious repository/state tampering is outside scope. The protected scope is accidental drift, stale authority, workflow inconsistency, improper lifecycle progression, and unintended Human Gate bypass.

## Reproduced defect

At `VALIDATED_DRAFT`, legitimately regenerated publication-facing bytes after a reviewed shared-Core change caused fail-closed drift against the historical `DRAFT_COMPLETE` validation checkpoint. There was no sanctioned way to establish a new active publication basis without rewriting history or fabricating a Human decision.

## Repair

Adds generic `revalidate-publication-surface` authority rebinding for legitimately regenerated publication bytes while preserving historical checkpoints unchanged.

The hardened design uses:

- Production State `publication_revalidation_provenance: {path, sha256}` as the sole active-authority pointer.
- Versioned immutable records `publication-surface-revalidation-rN.json`.
- Exact `{path, sha256}` `supersedes` links between rounds; prior records remain byte-identical on disk.
- Establishment metadata for the sanctioned pre-decision state.
- Publication-surface-only supersession; all upstream checkpoint-bound bytes must remain exact.
- Existing manuscript, quality-bundle, semantic-review, visual-review, and PDF validation rerun on the new bytes.
- Post-decision agreement checks against Human-approved/freeze/release PDF bytes.
- No force/skip path, no W34-specific conditional, no Human decision generation.

Revalidation may be established only at `VALIDATED_DRAFT` with Architecture approved, Publication Preview pending, freeze/release pending, and Exception Gate inactive.

## Human Gates

The operation is machine authority maintenance only. It does not approve Publication Preview, freeze, release, or any other Human decision. Architecture approval provenance remains intact.

## Regression evidence

- Publication revalidation suite: 23/23 PASS (original T-cases plus N1-N10 authority-hardening coverage).
- Full `test_survey_*_v2.py` contract: 342 tests, 0 failures, 6 intentional legacy skips.
- Unreferenced records are inert; State SHA mismatch and record tamper fail closed.
- Multi-round immutable chain and historical-record tamper detection covered synthetically.
- Weekly and Special genericity coverage PASS.

## W34 disposable proof

On an exact disposable copy of `weekly/2026-W34-v2-work@f50d229162b7402c504c0978f72dab4b33052f5e`:

`VALIDATED_DRAFT -> revalidation authority establishment -> State validation PASS -> stage validation PASS -> RELEASE_CANDIDATE`, with Publication Preview still pending and historical `DRAFT_COMPLETE.json` byte-identical. The real W34 branch was not modified.

## Exact-head CI

Frozen candidate `f3cdd485fe3d2ba922846b8e6cfc81d46f5bf259`:

- Survey Production Core v2 CI `34716001580` — SUCCESS
- Pipeline contract tests `34716001746` — SUCCESS

Fresh seven-point fixed-head audit for the hardened candidate: 7/7 PASS. The prior `2d8f7d2f...` audit was not reused.

## Residuals accepted by Human review

- Multi-round operation is synthetically covered but has no production second-round experience yet.
- `reason_class` currently supports `REVIEWED_CORE_CHANGE` only.
- Intentional malicious tampering by a trusted operator is outside the project threat model.

Approved candidate: `f3cdd485fe3d2ba922846b8e6cfc81d46f5bf259`.
